findings.problem: HTTPS is supported, but plain HTTP requests do not automatically upgrade to HTTPS.
findings.explanation: Users navigating directly to http://example.com may browse without encryption if an automatic 301 redirect is not enforced by the web server.
findings.recommendedSolution: Configure your web server (Nginx, Apache, Cloudflare) with a permanent 301 redirect from HTTP to HTTPS.

findings.problem: Missing critical security headers: Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options.
findings.explanation: Without critical headers like Content-Security-Policy, HSTS, and X-Frame-Options, modern browser-level safeguards remain inactive, significantly elevating risk of Clickjacking and XSS.
findings.recommendedSolution: Add Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy, and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN in your server or proxy headers.

findings.problem: Cookies implement recommended Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite protection flags.

findings.recommendedSolution: Continue to enforce HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Lax/Strict on all session cookies.
